title: Leaving keys with a neighbour
passage:
Would it be all right to leave the keys with my neighbour?
A. The key to the back gate is smaller.
B. I was there when she left.
C. Only if your neighbour can be here when we arrive.
passageZh:
可以把鑰匙留給我的鄰居嗎？
A. 後門鑰匙比較小。
B. 她離開的時候我在那裡。
C. 可以，但前提是我們抵達時你的鄰居能在場。
